scope: Five principal public-domain image sources plus one optional period portrait donor. No Lemony Snicket imagery or footage.

assets.title: Benjamin Franklin
assets.author: H. B. Hall, engraver, after Joseph-Siffred Duplessis (portrait from 1783)
assets.public_domain_basis: Public-domain historical artwork, published before 1929; faithful digitization supplied by the institution.
assets.modifications: Full-resolution TIFF-to-JPEG format conversion only; no creative alteration.
useful_elements: Recognizable bald head, side curls, face, shoulders and coat for a Franklin puppet
Fine engraved hatch marks for original faces and cloth shading

assets.title: An east prospect of the city of Philadelphia; taken by George Heap from the Jersey shore, under the direction of Nicholas Scull surveyor general of the Province of Pennsylvania / engrav'd by T. Jefferys.
assets.author: Thomas Jefferys, engraver, after George Heap under Nicholas Scull
assets.public_domain_basis: Public-domain historical artwork, published before 1929; faithful digitization supplied by the institution.
assets.modifications: Full-resolution TIFF-to-JPEG format conversion only; no creative alteration.
useful_elements: Long Philadelphia waterfront skyline for distant parallax layer
Sailing ships and separate church towers
Frontal State House inset for a clean colonial facade
Period street grid for map and ledger props
Unprinted beige paper around edges as scanned-paper texture

Engraved clouds for a separate moving sky layer
Foreground tree silhouettes and tiny townspeople
Worn paper margins and real plate impression
